Title: Register a new user with valid details
Preconditions: User is on the Toolshop home page and not logged in
Steps:
1. Navigate to https://practicesoftwaretesting.com/
2. Click Sign In or Register
3. Select Register / navigate to registration page
4. Enter valid first name last name email and password
5. Fill optional fields if required by form (DOB address phone)
6. Submit the registration form
TestData:
First Name: Test
Last Name: User
Email: testuser+{timestamp}@example.com
Password: Test@1234
DOB: 1990-01-15
ExpectedResult: User account is created successfully. Success message or redirect to login/home is displayed. No validation errors shown.

Title: Login with registered credentials and verify profile
Preconditions: User registered in TC-MAN-01 or a known valid account exists
Steps:
1. Navigate to https://practicesoftwaretesting.com/auth/login
2. Enter registered email and password
3. Click Login
4. Navigate to Account > Profile (or /account/profile)
5. Verify displayed profile information
ExpectedResult: User is logged in successfully. Profile page displays correct first name last name and email matching registration data.

Title: Login with invalid credentials shows error
Preconditions: User is on the login page and not logged in
Steps:
1. Navigate to https://practicesoftwaretesting.com/auth/login
2. Enter a valid-format email address
3. Enter an incorrect password
4. Click Login
5. Observe error message and page state
ExpectedResult: Login is rejected. An appropriate error message is displayed (e.g. invalid credentials). User remains on login page and is not redirected to account or checkout.

Title: Search for a product and open product detail page
Preconditions: User is on the Toolshop home page (logged in or guest)
Steps:
1. Navigate to https://practicesoftwaretesting.com/
2. Locate the Search field
3. Enter a known product name (e.g. Hammer)
4. Execute search
5. Click on a matching product from results
6. Verify product detail page loads
ExpectedResult: Search results display products matching the keyword. Product detail page opens showing product name price description and stock status. Add to Cart action is visible for in-stock items.

Title: Add multiple in-stock products to cart
Preconditions: User is logged in. At least two in-stock products are available in catalog
Steps:
1. Navigate to product catalog
2. Open first in-stock product detail page
3. Click Add to Cart
4. Return to catalog or search
5. Open second in-stock product detail page
6. Click Add to Cart
7. Open cart and verify items listed
TestData:
Product 1: Claw Hammer (or any in-stock item)
Product 2: Thor Hammer (or any other in-stock item)
ExpectedResult: Both products appear in the cart. Cart badge/count reflects total items. Each line shows correct product name price and quantity of 1.

Title: Update quantity of item in cart
Preconditions: User is logged in with at least one product already in cart (from TC-MAN-05 or manual setup)
Steps:
1. Navigate to cart page
2. Note current quantity and line total for first item
3. Increase quantity (e.g. from 1 to 2) using quantity control
4. Verify cart updates
5. Decrease quantity back to 1
6. Verify cart updates again
TestData:
Initial quantity: 1
Updated quantity: 2
Then reduced to: 1
ExpectedResult: Quantity updates are reflected immediately. Line total recalculates correctly (unit price x quantity). Cart subtotal updates accordingly. No errors displayed.

Title: Complete COD checkout generate invoice and verify in My Invoices
Preconditions: User is logged in with at least one product in cart
Steps:
1. Navigate to checkout (/checkout)
2. Verify cart items are present
3. Enter valid billing address details
4. Select payment method: Cash on Delivery
5. Review order summary
6. Click Confirm to place order
7. Click Confirm a second time (assessment requirement)
8. Verify order/invoice confirmation is displayed
9. Navigate to Account > My Invoices (/account/invoices)
10. Locate the newly created invoice in the list
11. Open invoice detail and verify line items and total match cart
TestData:
Billing Street: Zoey Shore
Billing City: Hesselbury
Billing State: Florida
Billing Country: TG
Billing Postal Code: 1234AA
Payment Method: Cash on Delivery
ExpectedResult: Checkout completes successfully with COD. Invoice is generated after pressing Confirm twice. Invoice appears in My Invoices with correct product line items quantities and total amount matching the order.

Title: Attempt checkout with empty cart is blocked
Preconditions: User is logged in. Cart is empty (no items added)
Steps:
1. Ensure cart has zero items (remove all items if needed)
2. Navigate directly to checkout (/checkout) or click Checkout
3. Observe application behavior
4. Attempt to proceed if any checkout step is shown
ExpectedResult: User cannot complete checkout with an empty cart. Application displays an error message empty-cart warning or redirects to catalog/cart. No invoice is generated.
